visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Integer Overflow in the Result
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Reversing 1534236469 should give 9646324351, but the program prints 1056389759.

solution.explanation: The reversed value 9646324351 is larger than the biggest int (2147483647), so an int silently wraps around to a wrong number. Use a long for the accumulator when the result may not fit in 32 bits.
